opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell Home, my name is Sanne. How can I help?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, as required.

verification.quote: Can I take your full name and your order number or postcode, please?
verification.comment: You asked for the full name and order number before looking up the order, which is exactly right.

understanding.quote: So you're asking when the €84.00 will be back on your card?
understanding.comment: You captured the refund question accurately and did not ask for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Refunds are paid within 5 working days of the return arriving, so it will be on your card within 5 working days from yesterday.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The 5 working day refund timeline is correct, but saying the refund will be on the card within 5 days from yesterday is a slightly firm promise since the refund is paid within 5 working days of arrival, so it is acceptable here.

process_compliance.quote: Can I put you on hold for a moment while I check the refund is queued?
process_compliance.comment: You asked permission before the hold and thanked her on return, which meets the hold steps; a photo was not required because this was a return, not a damaged item.

communication.quote: Thank you for waiting. It's queued, and you'll get an email the day it's paid.
communication.comment: The call was polite throughout and the caller showed no frustration, so no acknowledgement was needed.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I can help you with?
closing.comment: You confirmed the next step (email when paid) and asked if anything else was needed before closing politely.
